# input data

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(magrittr)

working_dir = "/Users/Yu_J/Downloads/Antic_DUX4/"

roi = read.table(paste0(working_dir,"/methylation/DUX4_ROI.bed"),header = FALSE,stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

wildtype = read.table(paste0(working_dir,"/methylation/add_DNA3_DNA7/reads_without_DUX4r_MAPQ1_methylation_mean.txt"))
dux4r = read.table(paste0(working_dir,"/methylation/add_DNA3_DNA7/reads_with_DUX4r_MAPQ1_methylation_mean.txt"))

## select on dux4 genes
wildtype = wildtype[wildtype$V4 %in% roi$V4,]
dux4r = dux4r[dux4r$V4 %in% roi$V4,]

wildtype$type = "Reads without DUX4r"
dux4r$type = "Reads with DUX4r"

mean(wildtype$V5)
mean(dux4r$V5)
```

## plot

```{r,fig.width=8,fig,highlight=3}
plot_data = rbind(wildtype,dux4r)
### calculate the mean per group
mean_with = subset(plot_data, type == "Reads with DUX4r")$V5 %>% mean() %>% round(2)
mean_without = subset(plot_data, type == "Reads without DUX4r")$V5 %>% mean() %>% round(2)

ggplot(plot_data,aes(x=type,y=V5,fill=type))+
  geom_violin()+
  ggpubr::stat_compare_means(method = "t.test",label.y = 25,label.x = 2.3,size=7)+
  coord_flip()+
  theme_classic()+
  ## add the mean value into the figure
  annotate("text",label = "Mean:           vs     ", y = 25, x = 0.5, size = 5) +
  annotate("text",label = mean_with, y = 26, x = 0.5, size = 5,color = "#F8766D") +
  annotate("text",label = mean_without, y = 44, x = 0.5, size = 5,color = "#00BFC4") +
  ylim(c(0,100.1))+
  theme(panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill=NA, linewidth=1),
        axis.text = element_text(size=20),
        axis.title = element_text(size=0),
        legend.position = "NULL")
```


# frequency overview

## reads level

```{r, fig.height=3,fig.width=16}
data = readxl::read_xlsx(path = paste0(working_dir,"Overview_gene annotations_13.06.2025.xlsx"),sheet = "overview")
data$count = 1


data %>% 
  group_by(left_pos_corrected,left_gene_corrected) %>%
  summarise(sum = sum(count)) -> data1


data1$left_pos_corrected = as.numeric(data1$left_pos_corrected) 
data1 = data1[data1$left_pos_corrected != 0,]
data1 = data1[data1$left_pos_corrected <= 100136190,]

ggplot(data1,aes(x=left_pos_corrected,y=sum,label=left_gene_corrected,fill=left_gene_corrected))+
  geom_segment( aes(x=left_pos_corrected, xend=left_pos_corrected, y=0, yend=sum),color = "grey") +
  geom_point(aes(size=sum), alpha=0.7, shape=21) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(1, 15))+
  xlim(c(min(data1$left_pos_corrected),max(data1$left_pos_corrected+100)))+
  ylim(c(0,max(data1$sum+2)))+
  geom_text(hjust=-0.1,size=5,check_overlap = TRUE,angle=0)+
  labs(title = "Closest genes next to left breakpoints (reads level)")+
  # ggrepel::geom_label_repel(size=5) +
  # scale_x_log10()+
  theme_classic()+
  theme(legend.position = "NULL",
        plot.title = element_text(size=20),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size=20),
        axis.title = element_text(size=20),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size=20),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size=0)
        # axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
        # axis.line.y = element_blank()
        )
```

## sample level

```{r}
data1 = unique(data[,c("left_pos_corrected","left_gene_corrected","sample_name")])
data %>% 
  group_by(left_pos_corrected,sample_name) %>%
  summarise(sum = sum(count)) -> data1

data1 = merge(data1,unique(data[,c("left_pos_corrected","left_gene_corrected")]),by="left_pos_corrected")


data1$left_pos_corrected = as.numeric(data1$left_pos_corrected) 
data1 = data1[data1$left_pos_corrected != 0,]
data1 = data1[data1$left_pos_corrected <= 100136190,]

ggplot(data1,aes(x=left_pos_corrected,y=sum,label=left_gene_corrected,fill=left_gene_corrected))+
  geom_segment( aes(x=left_pos_corrected, xend=left_pos_corrected, y=0, yend=sum),color = "grey") +
  geom_point(aes(size=sum), alpha=0.7, shape=21) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(1, 15))+
  xlim(c(min(data1$left_pos_corrected),max(data1$left_pos_corrected+100)))+
  ylim(c(0,max(data1$sum+2)))+
  geom_text(hjust=-0.1,size=5,check_overlap = TRUE,angle=0)+
  labs(title = "Closest genes next to left breakpoints (reads level)")+
  # ggrepel::geom_label_repel(size=5) +
  # scale_x_log10()+
  theme_classic()+
  theme(legend.position = "NULL",
        plot.title = element_text(size=20),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size=20),
        axis.title = element_text(size=20),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size=20),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size=0)
        # axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
        # axis.line.y = element_blank()
        )
```
